changes.before: CyberSentinel provides a working gateway and controlled design evidence. Structural features add 64.07 percentage points of internal recall. Validation controls reveal format–class association; a fixed-weight intervention establishes external scheme sensitivity. A separate refit removes that sensitivity across 8,622 pairs while reducing true and false positives, distinguishing stability from detection quality.
changes.after: CyberSentinel shows how to judge a gateway as a whole system. Structural features add 64.07 percentage points of internal recall, while controls reveal format–class association and fixed-weight tests show external scheme sensitivity. A separate refit removes that sensitivity across 8,622 pairs while reducing true and false positives together, showing why stability and detection quality need separate tests.

changes.before: External-window sensitivity reaches 87.12%; escalation adds 218 false positives without another gold detection. The models' 2,261 shared false positives among 2,497 certified negatives impose an exact 90.5487% floor on unchanged-decision selection. Wider gates on a separate cohort select no repairs and add 18 false positives. Count available corrections before choosing an expert; evaluate the policy by its selections.
changes.after: Choosing between the models' unchanged decisions carries a 90.5487% false-positive floor: 2,261 shared false positives among 2,497 certified negatives. Wider gates on a separate cohort add 18 false positives without repairs. The monitor recognizes 87.12% of external windows, yet escalation adds 218 false positives without another gold detection. Count available corrections; judge policies by their decisions.

changes.before: Worker-owned clients reduce median paired HTTP p95 by 79.68% in the single-host synthetic structural-only setup. A no-model control supports the client-path explanation; comparable predictions agree despite changed admission order. Expert scoring cost is measured separately. The complete gateway did not meet the prespecified joint criteria of H1–H3; the experiments identify what a redesign must address. CyberSentinel provides the next designer with a working architecture, a measured service improvement, a benchmark check and an exact routing bound.
